_README: PocketTracker configuration. config.json is YOURS: the app reads it at startup and never rewrites it. config.example.json beside it lists every setting at its default and is replaced at every launch, so a newer version's settings show up there - copy the lines you want into config.json. Every key is optional - delete a line to use the built-in default.
_README_gamepad: The Miyoo's buttons. On the left is the PocketTracker button, on the right the Miyoo buttons that press it: UP DOWN LEFT RIGHT A B X Y L1 L2 R1 R2 SELECT START MENU, plus L and R for both shoulders on a side. A button listed here REPLACES its built-in buttons rather than adding to them, and takes the buttons it lists away from any other button. All ten are listed so the whole map is in front of you; empty one ([]) if you want it unbound. A file from an older version names these in a "keyboard" section with key names ("Left Shift" for X) - that still works.
_README_shoulders: L takes L1 and L2, R takes R1 and R2, because the Mini+ has two shoulder rows and the Mini has one. Both rows do the same thing here rather than leaving half the buttons dead on the larger device.
_README_unbound: X and Y are unbound: PocketTracker has ten buttons and the Miyoo has twelve. To use them, put them on a button - for the shoulders on X and Y: "L": ["X"], "R": ["Y"]. MENU is left out for the same reason - bound to B it would make the system button cancel dialogs.
_README_repeat: Holding a direction: delay = ms before it starts repeating, interval = ms between repeats at full speed (it starts at twice that and speeds up over about a second). Smaller is faster. delay 100-2000, interval 16-500.
_README_folders: Where a LOAD browse STARTS for each category. A plain name is inside your PocketTracker folder ("Samples", "Samples/Packs"); an absolute path ("/mnt/SDCARD/Music") is used as given. A folder this device cannot read is ignored. This does not change where anything is SAVED.
